content: prefers-reduced-motion: detects OS-level reduce motion preference. Vestibular disorders (dizziness, nausea) from parallax/zooming/large movements. Opt-in pattern preferred (base no-motion, add when no-preference). Custom property toggle: --duration tokens collapse to near-zero. Keep: opacity fades <200ms, subtle color changes, focus rings, progress indicators. Remove: parallax, large slide-ins, zooming, infinite spinners. For WebGL: stop animation loop, render static frame or slow loop. Performance degradation via navigator.hardwareConcurrency + matchMedia. 92%+ browser support.
